{{Quote|I was trained as a Mandalorian, but I found purpose, profit, and a home in the Dar'manda.|Bask Sunn|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref>}}
'''Bask Sunn''' was a [[Dar'manda]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Recruitment officer/Legends|recruitment officer]] and a former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], who represented the Dar'manda in [[Heta Kol]]'s organization known as the [[Hidden Chain]] during the [[third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" /> around [[3626 BBY]]<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref>. Sunn was a [[Combat Master|Mandalorian Combat Master]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Get me one with the gold highlights. Is that extra? You know what, who cares? Just get it and have it shipped here. Can you do that, Jaff? Grab a box of those chocolate things as well. No nuts this time or I shoot you in the leg.|Bask Sunn, Dar'manda Lieutenant, Mandalorian Combat Master, Successful Entrepreneur|<ref name="TOR" />}}
In [[3626 BBY]], Bask Sunn lead a group of Dar'manda to attack the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'' alongside [[Clan Varad]] and the [[Ash'ad]] at the behest of Heta Kol. He was confronted by the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Rass Ordo]], who bested him in combat. He pleaded for his life by giving the Commander and Rass a set of codes and a [[Stardust Glider|personal transport]] that would enable them to carry on destroying the tethers that were latched to the ''Spirit of Vengeance II'', and was subsequently spared by Rass. He later reported to [[Heta Kol]] following their retreat from the ship, who gave him new orders.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" /> He then also sent a message asking the Commander for his transport back, since it was part of a matching set.<ref name="Quick">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=message|Quick question|Bask Sunn}}</ref>

[[File:Bask_Sunn_on_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Bask Sunn on Ruhnuk]]
Bask was later present in the Hidden Chain meeting when [[Ri'kan Kateen]] reunited with the group and brought his sister, the rogue Jedi Padawan [[Sa'har Kateen]], to Heta Kol.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Digging Deeper|[[Carrick Station]]}}</ref>

{{GameLS}}
Bask Sunn would ultimately lose his life following the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]].<ref name="Old Wounds" />
{{Endgame}}
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
During the duel between Heta Kol and Shae Vizla, the player takes notice of Bask Sunn using a weapon to hinder Shae Vizla, without Heta's knowledge, so that Bask can gain a huge profit over Shae's defeat and he gives the player three options on how to proceed regarding the duel:
*'''Disable the weapon for light side points''' - Shae Vizla overpowers and defeats Heta Kol in front of the Hidden Chain. Bask will then attempt to hurt the player to which the player can either knock him out or kill him.<ref name="battle">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref>
*'''Turn the weapon on Heta Kol for dark side points''' - The Commander knocks Bask Sun and then points the sonic disruptor on Heta who is suddenly unable to move freely, and Shae manages to defeat her, but the Hidden Chain does not acknowledge the victory and neither does Shae. Bask will then attempt to hurt the player to which the player can either knock him out or kill him.<ref name="battle" />
*'''Leave the weapon as it is for dark side points''' - Shae will lose the fight and Bask Sunn promises to have Dar'manda not only leave the Hidden Chain but also support the player's faction in the war. Saboteurs have the modified option where they leave the machine but tell Bask Sunn to support the opposing faction (Republic for Imperial saboteurs and Empire for Republic saboteurs) instead to his confusion to which he agrees to regardless.<ref name="battle" />

In the following '''Update 7.3: Old Wounds''', if the player had chosen to destroy Sunn's weapon or used it on Heta, Heta will figure out his interference in her duel against Shae. If the player had spared Sunn, Heta will have him flushed out the airlock. If the player had taken Sunn's deal, Heta will be unaware of his treachery and assumed he had pulled Dar'manda out of the Hidden Chain once he received his payment.<ref name="Old Wounds">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>
